title: Security tightened after unrest erupts at Magazine Prison
byline: A tense situation erupted at the Magazine Prison in Borella tonight (06), prompting authorities to tighten security in and around the facility.

title: Why watching videos while driving is dangerous?
byline: Police have urged motorists to avoid watching cooking videos or any other entertainment while driving, warning that even a few seconds of distraction can lead to fatal consequences.

title: Bravo Mr. President but please address the reality of your people too
byline: In a span of over one and a half years in office, you have lived up to your word and a kept a key election pledge that those who were embroiled in corruption in the previous governments would be taken to task and justice would be served to the people of this nation.

title: Motorcycle lanes coming in future: Minister
byline: The dedicated lanes for motorcycles will be introduced on roads across the country in the future, Transport Minister Bimal Ratnayake told Parliament today.

title: Mobile Number Portability service will not launch in September
byline: The end of September is the deadline for telecom companies to reach an agreement on implementing Mobile Number Portability (MNP), and not the date for launching the service, the Ministry of Digital Economy said.

title: Two inmates killed, two injured in clash at Kuruwita Prison
byline: Two inmates were killed and two others injured following a clash among a group of inmates at Kuruwita Prison on Friday morning, according to the Kuruwita Police.

title: Betty, 97, breaks record for oldest wingwalker
byline: A 97-year-old woman who suffered a stroke in 2025 has broken the Guinness World Record for being the oldest female wing walker.

title: Unrest at New Magazine Prison leaves 11 inmates injured
byline: Eleven inmates were injured after unrest broke out at New Magazine Prison close to midnight yesterday, prompting prison authorities to bring the situation under control with the assistance of the Sri Lanka Police and the Police Special Task Force (STF).

title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
byline: A US judge in New Mexico on Thursday ordered Meta to pay another $567m (£421m) for its failure to warn the public about dangers its platforms posed to children, marking the largest ruling against the company over child safety.

title: Unrest erupts at Kuruwita Prison
byline: A tense situation has erupted among inmates at the Kuruwita Prison today (07), leading to disruptions within the facility.

title: Tear gas fired as Pallansena Prison unrest escalates
byline: Police fired tear gas to control a tense situation at the Pallansena Open-Air Correctional Centre in Dalupotha, Negombo, after a group of inmates staged a protest on the prison roof.

title: 10,000 schools to be linked online under digital transformation plan
byline: The government plans to connect all 10,000 schools across Sri Lanka to the internet through fibre, 4G, 5G or satellite technology as part of an ambitious digital transformation drive aimed at modernising the education sector, Additional Secretary to the Prime Minister A.B.M. Ashraf said.

title: MP Archchuna shares salary sheet, claims increase in MPs’ fuel allowance
byline: Independent Parliamentarian Ramanathan Archchuna has shared his monthly salary sheet on his official Facebook page, highlighting what he claimed was an increase in the allowances received by Members of Parliament.

title: Central Hills reservoirs near overflow levels due to heavy rains
byline: Water levels in several reservoirs in the western slopes of the Central Hills have risen sharply following intermittent heavy rainfall, with some reservoirs reaching or exceeding overflow levels, officials said.

title: Strong winds of up to 50 kmph forecast for several provinces
byline: Strong winds of around 40–50 kmph are expected at times over the North Central, North Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central and Southern provinces due to the active south-west monsoonal conditions, the Meteorology Department warned.

title: Justice Minister should make a statement on unrest in prisons immediately: Sajith
byline: Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa urged the Minister of Justice, who is also in charge of prisons, to immediately make a statement on the unrest in prisons.

title: Man arrested for filming near IGP, Chief Justice residences
byline: A 40-year-old man has been arrested by the Cinnamon Gardens Police for allegedly recording videos of roads surrounding the official residences of the Inspector General of Police (IGP) and the Chief Justice in Colombo.

title: Kananathan Hails President Alassane Ouattara Côte d’Ivoire’s Economic Transformation on Independence Day
byline: Former High Commissioner  Kananathan Congratulates Côte d’Ivoire President Alassane Ouattara on Independence Day, Commends Nation’s Economic Rise

title: UNP calls for the suspension of constitution amendment to extend retirement age of judges
byline: Citing that the assessment report of European Union (EU) assessment report on Sri Lanka does not recommend extending the retirement age of judges, United National Party (UNP) working committee yesterday approved a resolution to call for the suspension of the constitution amendment which has been brought by the government to its effect.

title: Daily dengue cases drop to 350 from 1,300 amid control measures: Health Ministry
byline: Although Sri Lanka remains under a high dengue alert, the number of daily dengue cases has declined from around 1,300 to 350-400 due to control measures and programmes implemented in recent months, the National Dengue Control Unit Director, Specialist Dr. Kapila Kannangara said.

title: Malwatta Mahanayake raises concerns over Animal Welfare Bill’s impact on peraheras
byline: Mahanayake of Malwatta Chapter Ven.Thibbatuwawe Sri Sumangala Siddhartha Thera warned that the proposed Animal Welfare Bill would create obstructions to the Kandy Esala Perahera and other Perahera festivals and that the elephants marching in processions without adequate security methods is a risky undertaking.

title: Speaker, MP Hector Appuhamy clash in Parliament
byline: Speaker Jagath Wickramaratne and Opposition MP Hector Appuhamy engaged in a verbal clash in Parliament during the oral question session today.

title: Unrest reported at Pallansena Prison in Negombo
byline: A tense situation has been reported at the Pallansena Prison in Negombo, according to police.

title: Inmate dies following New Magazine Prison unrest
byline: An inmate who was receiving treatment after being injured during the unrest at New Magazine Prison has died.

title: Artificial Intelligence used to design brand new viruses
byline: Artificial Intelligence has been used to design brand new viruses that are fully functional and can replicate in the laboratory, say US researchers.

title: 14 injured after van plunges into precipice in Bulathsinhala
byline: Fourteen people were injured after a van veered off the road and fell into a precipice in the Udugalakanda area of Bulathsinhala this morning (7).

title: Trump signs orders to limit US birthright citizenship, despite Supreme Court ruling
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump signed two executive orders on Thursday in a new but narrower attempt to curtail birthright citizenship, once again challenging a provision of the U.S. ​Constitution even though the Supreme Court rejected his previous effort.

title: Judges retirement age extension: Bill gazetted
byline: The Gazette containing the Bill for the proposed 22nd Amendment to the Constitution has been published, proposing to revise the retirement ages of superior court judges and increase the number of judges in the Court of Appeal.

title: Four arrested over Rs. 14.1 Mn gold theft in Mount Lavinia
byline: Police have arrested four suspects in connection with the theft of gold items worth Rs. 14.1 million from a house in Mount Lavinia.

title: Lakshman Yapa Abeywardena granted bail
byline: Former Investment Promotion Minister Lakshman Yapa Abeywardena has been granted bail by the Colombo High Court after being served with indictments in connection with an alleged bribery case.

title: Eight dead, including teen suspect's grandparents, in Thailand shooting
byline: First he shot dead his grandparents, using his grandfather’s handgun, then went to a secondary school in Nonthaburi province, bordering Bangkok, and killed three teachers and three students, national police said in a statement.

title: Senanayake Samudraya fisheries anchorage proposal reviewed
byline: Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources Ramalingam Chandrasekar has reviewed the long-standing request by Monaragala District fishermen to establish a fisheries anchorage at Senanayake Samudraya during a field inspection visit to the reservoir.

title: Academic activities of Peradeniya university to resume
byline: Academic activities at the University of Peradeniya, which were temporarily suspended owing to adverse weather conditions, will resume from August 10.

title: Badulla reservoirs spill, downstream warning issued
byline: The Irrigation Department has warned people living in downstream areas of reservoirs and waterways to remain vigilant as two reservoirs in the Badulla district are currently spilling.

title: Over 271,000 helmet-related cases filed so far this year
byline: Sri Lanka Police have filed 271,890 cases relating to safety helmet violations during the first seven months of 2026, highlighting continued non-compliance among motorcycle riders.

title: Security tightened at Jaffna prison as military and Police deployed
byline: Amid growing tensions reported at several prisons across the country, security measures at the Jaffna Prison have been intensified.

title: President calls for emergency meeting over unrest at prisons: Minister
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has called for a meeting of all stakeholders involved in prisons today, Minister of Public Security Ananda Wijepala informed Parliament.

title: Road to the title begins tomorrow: SLSRFA Elite U18 Rugby 7s Knockout Battle Set
byline: The Day 2 knockout schedule of the SLSRFA Elite Under-18 Rugby 7s Tournament will take place tomorrow (Aug.08)) at the Royal Sports Complex Grounds. The top schoolboy teams will compete across the Cup, Bowl and Shield categories.

title: Joint mechanism to be established to ensure safety of inmates
byline: A joint mechanism comprising prison officials, the Police, the Special Task Force (STF), the Tri-Forces and other relevant stakeholders will be established to strengthen the safety and welfare of inmates in all 33 prisons across the country.

title: Injured inmates transferred to Welikada Hospital
byline: Twenty-eight inmates who sustained injuries during the unrest at the Pallansena Prison have been transferred to the Welikada Prison Hospital for medical treatment, prison authorities said.

title: Elite Joes brought down by Maliyadeva
byline: After the completion of the league matches of the Under 18 Elite Rugby Sevens tournament at the Royal Sports Complex ground in Reid Avenue, the eight teams to qualify for the Cup quarter finals were found after the fancied St. Joseph’s College went down to the unfancied Maliyadeva College.

title: Justice Minister warns of attempts to incite prisoners
byline: Justice and National Integration Minister Harshana Nanayakkara has alleged that certain individuals with ulterior motives are attempting to manipulate inmates to create unrest in prisons, while urging prisoners not to fall prey to the interests of a few individuals.

title: Senior Police officers transferred, subject to NPC approval
byline: Several senior police officers, including Senior Deputy Inspectors General of Police (SDIGs) and Assistant Superintendents of Police (ASPs), have been transferred in a major reshuffle initiated by the Police Headquarters.

title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
byline: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have signed a joint defence agreement, saying an attack on one of them would be seen as an attack on all three.

title: Free entry for for Sri Lanka-India Test series
byline: Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) has announced free public admission for the upcoming ICC World Test Championship Test series between Sri Lanka and India.

title: Jaffna Court orders Gotabaya to give online testimony in disappearance case
byline: The Jaffna Magistrate’s Court has ordered former Defence Secretary Gotabaya Rajapaksa to appear in person before the Colombo Chief Magistrate’s Court on September 29 and provide testimony online in connection with the case concerning the disappearance of Lalith Kumar Weeraraj and Kugan Muruganandhan in Jaffna.

title: Control restored at Kuruvita and Pallansena prisons
byline: The situation at both the Kuruvita and Pallansena prisons has now been brought under control following unrest reported at the two facilities, the Prison Department said.

title: Heavy showers, strong winds on the cards in several areas
byline: Showers or thundershowers are expected at times in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-Western provinces, as well as in the Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Galle and Matara districts, the Department of Meteorology said.

title: CID Director Shani Abeysekara promoted to Deputy Inspector General of Police
byline: Director of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) Shani Abeysekara, has been promoted to the rank of Deputy Inspector General (DIG) of Police.

title: 100 days of Chemmani Excavations – Human Skeletal Remains Surpass 500
byline: Excavation work at the Chemmani mass grave site reached its 100th day today, with the number of human skeletal remains recovered from the site surpassing 500.

title: In Quest for Gold, Pathirage Braved Every Demon
byline: Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage traded his bat for the Javelin, survived wild elephant attacks and drove a mini truck in the dead of night just to realise his Olympic Dream.

title: Rice supplier fined Rs. 1 mn for selling Red Nadu above MRP
byline: A rice supplier has been fined Rs. 1 million by the Polonnaruwa Magistrate’s Court after being found guilty of selling Red Nadu rice above the government-imposed Maximum Retail Price (MRP), the Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) said.

title: 22nd Amendment gazetted amidst warning by President’s Counsels
byline: As the government gazetted the 22nd Amendment to the Constitution to extend the retirement age of Supreme Court judges to 67 and Court of Appeal judges to 65, a group of senior President’s Counsels warned of tough action to force the government to abandon the proposed amendment.

title: CSE rally continues as broad buying pushes ASPI toward 21,400
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange extended its positive momentum for a third consecutive session on Friday, 7 August 2026, as broad-based buying interest pushed both benchmark indices higher and strengthened overall market sentiment.

title: No impact on Kandy Esala Perahera from Animal Welfare Act: Governor
byline: There is no need for public concern that the proposed Animal Welfare Act will affect the Kandy Esala Perahera or other traditional cultural events, Central Province Governor Dr. Harsha Suranga Fernando said.

title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
byline: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have signed a joint defence agreement, saying an attack on one of them would be seen as an attack on all three.
